acceptanceCriteria: A fixture exceeding 4096 lookups yields unresolved (not not-a-constant) and is not cached
Test fails if the bound is removed
body: Residual from PR #1096 (V1-1698): the hop bound (8) and template depth bound (8) have tests; the 4096 total-lookup bound returns unresolved but has no dedicated test.
title: Add a regression test for the 4096-lookup bound in shared-constant setup resolution
